name: Intelsat (public ephemeris) Data Source
description: Executable data-source (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no hostcalls but plugin.getConfig): request turns a TimerTick into the GET HttpRequest of the public MyIntelsat ephemeris listing (config listingUrl); select_file turns the listing's HttpResponse into the GET of the newest ECF (_e_) file of the target satellite (config target, ephemerisBase); emit turns that file's HttpResponse into one SDS $OEM (position-only, ECEF/UTC as declared, metres normalised to km, NORAD 0), consumed in memory by analysis/od.fit and never stored. hostcap/http-request makes both fetches. A transport error, a status other than 200, an empty body, a listing without the target's ECF file or a file without data rows fails closed. Nothing is stored, signed or published.

methods.displayName: Request the Intelsat public ephemeris listing
methods.description: A TimerTick -> one GET HttpRequest for the Intelsat public ephemeris listing (config listingUrl, default my.intelsat.com/ephemeris/public), for hostcap/http-request. The flow's trigger sets the cadence; the provider's suggested one is every 24 h (the former module timer intelsat-pull).

acceptedTypeSets.description: The flow trigger firing (TimerTick, TICK); its fields are not read.

inputPorts.description: The flow trigger firing (TimerTick, TICK); its fields are not read.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) for the Intelsat public ephemeris listing.

outputPorts.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) for the Intelsat public ephemeris listing.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for the Intelsat listing: STATUS 200 with BODY the file verbatim.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method turns one frame into the next request or the parsed ephemeris on the calling thread; the host parallelizes independent sources and this module creates no threads.
